summary.name: AirOps
summary.one_liner: AirOps is a marketing platform and services team that helps brands build and execute an AI discovery (AI search) strategy, using agents, data, and brand governance to research, publish, and refresh content.
use_cases: Measuring brand market share in AI-generated recommendations
Planning channel mix for AI discovery
Automating research, publishing and refreshing of SEO and AEO content
Tracking AI search results against pipeline and revenue
Governing brand voice across AI-produced content
summary.what_it_does: The page describes AirOps as a service plus platform for AI discovery strategy: it works with a brand to set strategy and then execute it. It says the platform tracks AI visibility and market share against competitors, identifies which channels most influence AI recommendations, and builds a funnel strategy around them. For execution it describes agents that research, publish, and refresh content, with brand governance, and a system that learns from each run. It also states results are tied back to pipeline and revenue. Customer quotes and research links are present but were not evaluated.
notable: Measures market share in AI answers, not just a visibility score
Agent-based system to research, publish and refresh content that improves over runs
Hands-on team support from strategy through execution
Ties AI discovery results to pipeline and revenue
caveats: Page is mostly marketing; no pricing tiers, feature list or technical details are given
Hands-on managed service model; tailored engagement rather than self-serve described on the page
Freemium status comes from the directory listing, not the page itself
